measured_baseline.result_interpretation: Evidence baseline only; not a mandatory chapter length or accepted-art claim.

required_narrative_phases.requirement: Establish current state, goal, geography, and departure or initiating change.
Advance through causal travel/action beats with at least one readable obstacle or warning.
Cross or refuse a meaningful threshold; preserve role order and spatial consequence.
Use hands, tools, terrain, and story objects to produce or reveal evidence.
Let characters interpret evidence and make a consequential choice through readable action/dialogue.
Deliver a changed-state reveal, return vector, cliffhanger, or earned closure.

panel_rules.identity: panel_id is stable; plan_revision_id changes whenever intent changes
panel_rules.adult_cast: only explicitly named fictional adults; zero-person inserts use an empty list
panel_rules.causal_action: name body/tool/terrain/object relationships; generic speed-line texture cannot substitute
panel_rules.lettering: at least one normalized safe zone or explicit outside-art/gutter policy; never cover faces, people, important hands, or story objects
panel_rules.continuity: every carried prop, injury, garment, weather state, location vector, and clue must have explicit carry-in/out
panel_rules.progression: armor, weapons, upgraded clothing, monsters, classes, and system UI require explicit story/canon bindings

sequence_rules.coverage: every panel appears in exactly one sequence and every sequence is contiguous in display order
sequence_rules.generation_strategy: coherent sequence-first generation may be proposed only after plan/prompt/upload preflight; deterministic crops and panel-local repair preserve non-target hashes

WIDE_DIRECTIONAL_ANCHOR.copy: silent or minimal; use 1200 for tested two-line in-art copy

WIDE_ENVIRONMENTAL_MOTION.copy: normally silent; outside-art caption only after plan revision

TALL_OR_WIDE_DUAL_CAUSAL.function: two-person practical action with literal leverage/hand geometry
TALL_OR_WIDE_DUAL_CAUSAL.copy: keep action silent; do not trade causal geometry for a balloon

MEDIUM_SINGLE_CAUSAL.copy: keep action silent or move approved caption outside art

MEDIUM_TWO_SHOT.copy: if attributed speech is required, test 1200 or revise plan semantics

MEDIUM_CHARACTER_CLUE.copy: tested two-line in-art copy requires 1200; otherwise outside-art caption is only a plan-revision option

SMALL_OBJECT_INSERT.copy: no dialogue; do not shrink lettering into the art

SMALL_SENSORY_INSERT.copy: prefer silence; caption band requires plan revision

MEDIUM_SENSORY_REACTION.copy: speech needs literal speaker semantics and 1200 test footprint

chapter_acceptance_gates: all declared ComicPanelPlans present exactly once
opening and closing states are materially different
continuity carry-in/out graph is closed or explicitly cliffhanging
variable cadence contains action/reveal anchors and lower-density relief beats
all lettering placements preserve protected subjects at phone width
every provider execution has a complete RenderRecord
human review minutes and decisions are explicit
commercial clearance and exact-production-base decisions remain separate

soren.adult_presentation: clearly mature fictional adult; lean sturdy build; weathered angular face; light stubble where visible
